method: Arm A (naive substring on name+description) selected 62; Arm B (marketplace agent) matched 58. The 5 records selected by Arm A only were inspected individually against the task criterion: does the agent's OWN registry metadata indicate yield-optimisation capability?

records.name: positioncrew-yield-optimizer.agent
records.description_excerpt: Compares block-pinned Venus stablecoin markets and returns a liquidity-, concentration-, migration-cost-, and risk-bounded allocation or HOLD.
records.adjudication: TRUE POSITIVE missed by Arm B
records.reasoning: The description describes yield allocation across Venus lending markets, which satisfies the criterion. The word 'yield' appears only in the NAME, and the classifier's description-precedence rule ignores name evidence when a description exists. This is a FALSE NEGATIVE for the marketplace agent.

records.name: defi_yield_optimizer.agent
records.description_excerpt: Helping investors and protocols maximize capital efficiency across DeFi ecosystems.
records.adjudication: TRUE POSITIVE missed by Arm B
records.reasoning: 'maximize capital efficiency across DeFi' is yield optimisation in substance; 'yield' appears only in the name. Same false-negative mechanism.

records.name: DeFi-Yield-Optimizer.agent
records.description_excerpt: DeFi automation expert helping users maximize yields through intelligent optimization strategies and automated portfolio management.
records.adjudication: TRUE POSITIVE missed by Arm B
records.reasoning: Description says 'maximize yields ... optimization strategies'. Note the plural 'yields' does not match the classifier's \byield\b word-boundary pattern in the same form as its phrase table expects for this record, so it was not matched. FALSE NEGATIVE.

records.adjudication: FALSE POSITIVE correctly rejected by Arm B

records.adjudication: FALSE POSITIVE correctly rejected by Arm B
records.reasoning: A persona/commentator profile with no yield-optimisation capability. Arm A selected it on incidental keyword presence. Arm B correctly excluded it.

summary.conclusion: Neither arm is strictly superior on correctness in this test. Arm B eliminated 2 clear false positives and supplied per-record justification, but missed 3 genuine yield agents because its description-precedence rule discards name evidence when any description exists. This is recorded as a real limitation, not smoothed over.
